title: Finite type algebras over G-rings are G-rings
statement: Let $R$ be a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. If $R\to S$ is of finite type, meaning that $S$ is a finitely generated $R$-algebra (equivalently, a quotient of $R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$), then $S$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] (Stacks Project, More on Algebra, Proposition Tag 07PV).

source.place: More on Algebra, Proposition 07PV (tag 07PV, label proposition-finite-type-over-G-ring, line 12552), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PV; the proposition states the finite type case used here, and its proof reduces to polynomial extensions and localizations. It is invoked by Proposition 07PX (tag 07PX), item (5).
